Contact Me

Stay Connected with Elaine Sciolino

Thank you for your interest in my work! Whether you’re a reader, journalist, student, or simply someone who loves exploring history, culture, and storytelling, I would love to hear from you. Feel free to reach out to me for inquiries, collaborations, or just to share your thoughts about my books and articles.

Get in Touch

\ud83d\udccd Location: Paris, France & New York, USA
✉️ Email: elaine.sciolino@example.com
\ud83d\udcde Phone: +1 (212) 555-7890

For professional inquiries, book discussions, or media requests, please contact me via email. I try to respond to all messages, but due to a high volume of emails, please allow some time for a reply.

Follow Me on Social Media

Stay updated with my latest articles, interviews, and book releases by following me on social media.

\ud83d\udd39 Twitter/X: @ElaineSciolino – Join the conversation and get updates on my latest work.

\ud83d\udd39 Instagram: @ElaineSciolino – Behind-the-scenes glimpses of my research, travels, and personal inspirations.

\ud83d\udd39 Facebook: Elaine Sciolino – Connect with me for discussions on books, culture, and history.

\ud83d\udd39 LinkedIn: Elaine Sciolino – For professional connections, speaking engagements, and collaborations.

Speaking Engagements & Book Events

I frequently participate in book fairs, literary festivals, and cultural discussions around the world. If you are interested in inviting me for an event, please contact my team at events@elaineevents.com.

\ud83d\udcc5 Upcoming Events:

  • Paris Book Festival – September 15, 2025

  • New York Times Talks – October 10, 2025

  • History & Culture Symposium, London – November 5, 2025

Stay tuned for more events and book signings near you!

Media & Press Inquiries

For interviews, media appearances, and article collaborations, please reach out to my publicist:

\ud83d\udce7 Press Contact: press@elainepress.com
\ud83d\udcde Media Requests: +1 (646) 555-1234

I appreciate the opportunity to share insights on journalism, France, and storytelling with new audiences.

Join the Conversation

If you’ve read my books or articles, I’d love to hear your thoughts! Join discussions using the hashtag #ElaineSciolino on social media and connect with fellow readers who share a love for culture, history, and great storytelling.

Let’s stay connected and continue exploring the world through words. I look forward to hearing from you!

\ud83d\udcd6 Happy Reading! \ud83d\udcd6
